import hashlib, json, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path

source = Path('products/distribution/catalogue-editor-example-placement/release-owner-handoff')
output = source / 'buyer-download-execution.json'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    work = Path(directory)
    names = {
        'verify.py': 'served-verify.py.txt',
        'verify_example.py': 'served-verify_example.py.txt',
        'transform.py': 'served-transform.py.txt',
        'before-variants.csv': 'served-before-variants.csv',
        'before-images.csv': 'served-before-images.csv',
        'after-shopify.csv': 'served-after-shopify.csv',
    }
    hashes = {}
    for name, capture in names.items():
        data = (source / capture).read_bytes()
        (work / name).write_bytes(data)
        hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    command = ['verify_example.py', 'before-variants.csv', 'before-images.csv', 'after-shopify.csv']
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, *command], cwd=work, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
receipt = {'command': ['python3', *command], 'input_sha256': hashes, 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr, 'scope': 'Offline execution of captured public downloads on fictional fixtures.'}
output.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
